en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal ceremony or conference in an auditorium. The room is decorated with large draped flags and a prominent emblem at the front: a post‑horn symbol beneath a crown, surrounded by the letters "P" and "F" and flanked by laurel‑like designs. Text around the emblem includes "75 ÅR" indicating a 75‑year anniversary. Rows of seated men in suits face a stage where several men stand beside a speaker at a lectern. On the stage and backdrop are flowers and a large decorative version of the post‑horn symbol.
